description:
## Google Maps for ReVanced GmsCore

- Adds inspected compatibility for Google Maps 26.35.04.969485213.
- Keeps support for Google Maps 26.33.02.961351034.
- Preserves BYD navigation-audio routing, existing ReVanced GmsCore compatibility, and original Google Maps voice-search behavior.

SHA-256 (patches-1.0.12.mpp): 15d99facef7019309de3ec4e3506400fd6931ad2d491a5961c442fc06bd1f9ea

patches.name: Google Maps for ReVanced GmsCore
patches.description: Routes supported Google Maps builds through ReVanced GmsCore using the patched Maps package and known Google Maps certificate spoof metadata.
